svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build strip base, Back, full-height Sides, Bottom / Top and shelves.
2. Keep the plain door-grip setback; do not add drawer-style grip channels.
3. Trial-fit its door and selected hinges, checking actual opening clearance.
4. Level and anchor the tower during installation before loading or final door fitting.
